scripts.deploy: npm run db:migrate && opennextjs-cloudflare build && opennextjs-cloudflare deploy

MAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Required. Encrypts IMAP, SMTP, and authenticator secrets. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Losing it means reconnecting every mailbox.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: Optional. Auto-provisions Email Routing and DNS checks. Needs **Zone:Read**, **DNS:Read**, and **Email Routing Rules:Edit**.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Optional. Your Cloudflare account ID, used with the API token for domain provisioning.

DB.description: D1 database for users, mailboxes, the message index, contacts, and API keys. Created automatically on deploy.

MAIL_BUCKET.description: R2 bucket for raw `.eml` files and attachments. Created automatically on deploy.

SESSION_STORE.description: KV namespace for sessions, rate limits, and shortcut overrides. Created automatically on deploy.

MAIL_INGEST.description: Queue that parses inbound MIME and notifies the mailbox Durable Object.

MAILBOX.description: Durable Object — one instance per mailbox for IMAP polling and live updates.

EMAIL.description: Send Email binding for native (non-IMAP) outbound mail.
